definitions.explanation: A spirit believed to watch over and protect a particular person throughout their life — often imagined as the soul of an ancestor or a benevolent spiritual being. A common figure in Japanese spiritualism and popular supernatural fiction, rather than in any one formal religion.

examples.japanese: {守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{守護霊|しゅごれい}になっている。
examples.english: I'm sure my grandfather is my guardian spirit now.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{霊能者|れいのうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: That spiritual medium says she can see people's guardian spirits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|のが}れた→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、「{守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けられた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{真顔|まがお}→真顔：13659_magao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{語|かた}っていた→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: Having escaped the big accident unharmed, he said with a straight face, "My guardian spirit saved me."

notes:
Composed of ⟦{守護|しゅご}→守護：12257_shugo⟧ (protection, guardianship) + ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧ (spirit, soul). Not a technical term from any one religious system, but a widely used word in Japanese popular spiritualism, occult entertainment, and casual conversation about luck and fate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{守|まも}られる→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to be protected by one's guardian spirit
- {守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: to be able to see (someone's) guardian spirit
- {守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧: the existence of a guardian spirit
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{守護霊|しゅごれい}: a strong guardian spirit
- ご{先祖様|せんぞさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{守護霊|しゅごれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: one's ancestors become one's guardian spirits

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背後霊|はいごれい}→背後霊：25015_haigorei⟧: a spirit standing behind someone — a related occult word; sometimes benevolent like a {守護霊|しゅごれい}, sometimes ambiguous or negative.
- ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧: ancestral spirits — a broader, more religious term; in Japanese folk belief, ancestral spirits often take on a guardian role toward living descendants.
- エンジェル / ⟦{天使|てんし}→天使：12174_tenshi⟧: angel — the Christian / Western equivalent; conceptually similar but culturally distinct.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Belief in {守護霊|しゅごれい} is widespread in Japanese popular culture but does not belong to any one religion. It draws on a loose blend of Buddhist ideas about ancestors, Shintō sensibilities about spirits, and modern spiritualism. The word appears frequently in TV programs about fortune-telling, psychic phenomena, and supernatural investigations; it is also a common motif in manga and anime.
